scope: Dispatch lock across three unchanged canonical facade writes and immutable publication receipt

findings.condition: The proposed unchanged-writer approach permits dispatch and canonical handles to refer to the same SQLite database, or share one connection.
findings.description: An outer dispatch BEGIN IMMEDIATE excludes the separate canonical connection writer on that file until lock timeout. Sharing the connection instead makes the canonical BEGIN nested; its exception rollback can release the dispatch transaction. Existing constructors accept paths/connections without a distinct-store topology guard.
findings.minimal_seam: For this separate-journal FIXTURE composition, explicitly validate existing distinct database identities before entering the lock, without creating another DB. If same-file composition must be supported, it requires a deliberate shared transaction-aware canonical storage API; do not call the current independent committing facade methods inside that same-file writer lock.
findings.regression: Exercise same-file separate connections and shared-connection topology: require deterministic refusal before canonical mutation, or prove transaction-aware supported behavior. Retain separate-existing-store recovery coverage.

findings.condition: The locked publisher invokes existing general guard/source/recovery or public publication marking paths.
findings.description: _write rejects an already active transaction. Existing source guards call ensure_run, recovery calls public mark_* and those paths start their own _write. Calling them while holding the new outer transaction therefore raises DISPATCH_IDLE_WRITER_REQUIRED; recursive recovery is also unsuitable for the pending batch itself.
findings.minimal_seam: Use one private finalization publish method owning exactly one _write. Within it use read-only lease/semantic inventory validators and an already-in-transaction exact receipt insert helper. Stage commits first. Invoke unchanged canonical writers only after topology validation; never call guard/recover/mark wrappers recursively under the lock.
findings.regression: Trap nested _write/guard/network calls while the locked publisher runs. Add failure after each canonical prefix and receipt insertion, then successor generation-two replay with zero provider requests and exact original prefix reuse.

supported_design_constraints: The connection-local PRAGMA data_version/total_changes tuple must remain an ephemeral local race fence; persisting it across own writes/restart cannot be authority. A stable semantic commitment to actual claimed rows and immutable canonical source objects is appropriate for replay.

Existing canonical_publication explicitly commits each fact and supports byte-exact idempotent prefix replay. A previously committed outbox can survive rollback of only a later dispatch receipt transaction, provided the canonical journal is distinct and every replay validates original source/facts.

In the inspected TradingCoordinator path each canonical writer returns after its commit before dispatch.mark_* starts; no existing simultaneous canonical-lock then dispatch-lock hold was found in that bounded path. This is not an all-repository deadlock absence claim.

The normalized replay graph must strip only the exact expected own CLOSED projection, binding and TradeResult payload commitments; reject different same-ID payloads or foreign facts. Test every zero/one/two/three-fact prefix, derived recovery/current-pointer changes and replay after a legitimate successor lease.

Claim/lease checks must occur after acquiring BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Do not run provider/network or E5 math under the lock, renew observations, suppress writer errors, or use semantic hashes as a caller-created permission.
limits: Design/source inspection only; no implementation/imports/tests/DB/Git/process/native/network/provider or tracked changes. Only this authorized new outside-Git review JSON was written.
These are concrete API/topology constraints on an unapplied proposal, not observed new production defects. Existing source/native scopes and H16 completion remain unclaimed.
